verdict.rationale: Modal's own docs describe Sandboxes as secure, isolated, ephemeral containers built for running untrusted user or agent code. They also document network controls (block_network, outbound domain and CIDR allowlists) and an agent example that runs LLM-generated code in a Sandbox. Missing for 10: documentation in the pack of the underlying isolation mechanism or security guarantees, and independent or hands-on corroboration of isolation strength.

support.subject: As a developer, I can execute untrusted, AI-generated code without risking my own infrastructure

citations.quote: Programmatically scale secure, ephemeral environments for running untrusted code.
secure containers for executing untrusted user or agent code
to safely execute arbitrary commands, run untrusted user code, or as a safe environment for AI agents
We execute the agent's code in a Modal Sandbox, which allows us to run arbitrary code in a safe environment.
